source.title: Grim Batol
source.description:
Nefarian has long been engaged in experimentation involving the five dragonflights, and it seems this "simulacrum" of the Dragon Soul was one such experiment. I shudder to think of what could come of him successfully emulating even a fraction of the power of the true Dragon Soul. Please, seek out agents of the red dragons near the ruins of Grim Batol.

I will enchant the simulacrum you carry to mark you as a friend of the red flight.
source.objective: Bring the Simulacrum of the Dragon Soul to the leader of the dragon host near the entrance to the fortress of Grim Batol.
source.progress: Who are you and why do you dare come before me, mortal?
source.completion: You bear the mark of an agent of Korialstrasz but as a stranger I still have no choice but to mistrust you, mortal. Mark or no, I advise that you tread carefully, lest I allow my dragonkin to incinerate and devour you.
